rationale: Vamsi brings full-stack development expertise in Python and TypeScript with hands-on ML projects in NLP and computer vision, while Kaushik leads ML engineering at Mytra with deep robotics and embedded systems experience. They share Python as a core language and ML domains, and could explore how Vamsi's computer vision and web application skills could complement Kaushik's autonomous systems work.
intro_message: Vamsi Krishna N K, meet Kaushik Prakash — you both work in ML and Python, and Kaushik's robotics expertise could be a great learning opportunity for your computer vision and full-stack background.
